<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
group(name: str, ranks: Tuple[int, ...], backend: Any = None) -> Group
```

Part of [`evoxc.dist`](/api/evoxc/dist/)

Create an explicit communication `Group`.

## Parameters

- `name` · `str` — Non-empty unique name for the group.

- `ranks` · `Tuple[int, ...]` — Tuple of participating ranks (non-empty, unique,
  non-negative ints).

- `backend` · `Any` — Optional backend binding; `None` lets the executing
  backend resolve the transport.

## Returns

- `Group` — A new (static, immutable) Group.

## Raises

- `ValueError` — empty name; empty, duplicated, negative or non-int
  rank entries.
